login.title: Sign in to Gdesk
login.subtitle: Connect your GitHub account to see your repositories, pull requests and notifications.

device.title: Sign in with your browser
device.description: Gdesk shows a code. Enter it on GitHub to approve this app.
device.copyFailed: Couldn’t copy the code. Select it and copy it manually.
device.waiting: Waiting for you to approve on GitHub…

status.expired: The code expired before it was approved. Get a new code to try again.
status.error: Browser sign-in couldn’t be completed. Check your connection and try again.

token.title: Sign in with a personal access token
token.recommend: We recommend a classic token with these scopes:
token.createLink: Create a classic token on GitHub
token.label: Personal access token
token.fineGrainedNote: Fine-grained tokens are accepted too, but Inbox (notifications) won’t work with them.

errors.invalidToken: GitHub rejected this token. Check that it’s correct and hasn’t expired.
errors.offline: Couldn’t reach GitHub. Check your connection and try again.
errors.httpError: GitHub returned an error. Try again in a moment.
errors.deviceFlowUnavailable: Browser sign-in isn’t available in this build. Use a token instead.

scopes.titleMissing: Your token is missing some permissions.
scopes.titleInboxUnavailable: Inbox is unavailable with this token.
scopes.fineGrained: Fine-grained tokens can’t read notifications. Use a classic token with the notifications scope to enable Inbox.

impact.privateReposAndStar: private repositories and starring won’t work.
impact.orgReposAndTeamReviews: organization repositories and team review requests won’t appear.
impact.inbox: Inbox is unavailable with this token.

reason.oauthApp: the organization must approve Gdesk before its repositories appear.
reason.saml: the organization uses SAML single sign-on. Authorize your session for it on GitHub.

expired.title: Your GitHub session has expired. Showing saved data (read-only).

storage.title: Your token can’t be stored securely
storage.description: No system keyring was found, so Gdesk can’t encrypt your token on this computer. Choose how to continue.
storage.saveExplain: Save anyway: the token is written to a file only your user account can read. Anyone with access to your account or a copy of the file could use it.
storage.memoryExplain: Don’t save: the token is kept in memory only, and you’ll sign in again every time you start Gdesk.

signOut.title: Sign out of GitHub?
signOut.description: Gdesk removes your token and fetched data from this computer. Pins, links and settings are kept.
